title: House Management
body: Everything that keeps the household running, in four sections. Nothing is invented: a section stays empty until it has a source, and says so.

title: No household tasks yet
body: Recurring chores and one-off jobs about the house. Tasks of the calendar account are on Profile > Tasks.

title: No bills yet
body: Rent, electricity, gas, water, internet and insurance, with their due dates. Budget figures live in Buro > Fin.

title: Inventory is empty
body: Appliances, furniture and stock, with where each one is and its warranty.

title: Nothing scheduled
body: Servicing, repairs and seasonal jobs, with the date of the last and the next.
